description: Convert content signals and audience problems into validated digital products and agentic MVPs.

phases.input: Audience behavior patterns, comment clusters, search signals, retention curves from content outputs
phases.action: Identify validated content signals that indicate customer problems worthy of product solutions
failure_conditions: No validated signal (retention < 30% + no positive sentiment + no search signal) = abandon signal tracking

phases.action: Diagnose the underlying problem the signal reveals; design customer interview protocol
failure_conditions: Diagnosis stops at symptom layer = rework; no interview protocol = abort

phases.input: Interview protocol from D1 + audience segments from E4
phases.action: Execute structured interviews; analyze responses; synthesize insights
failure_conditions: No structured analysis = abort; no memory updates = abort

phases.input: Diagnosis + interview analysis + content strategy (from C1 if available)
phases.action: Design product hypothesis: value prop, features, price, presell mechanism
failure_conditions: No content signal reference = abort; no presell mechanism = abort; missing failure conditions = abort

phases.action: Build MVP (Next.js + Stripe + database); include analytics hooks; ensure rollback mechanism
failure_conditions: No analytics hooks = stop; exceeds 7-day budget = stop; no rollback mechanism = stop

phases.action: Launch presell page; activate tracking; connect to content funnel
failure_conditions: No tracking hooks = abort; no connection to content = rework

phases.action: Analyze product performance; update strategic and creative memory; propose evolution
failure_conditions: No insight = abort; no evolution proposal = abort; failure not recorded = abort

phases.input: Validated product data + strategic memory + audience patterns
phases.action: Design and build agent-based layer (automation, AI assistant, intelligence layer) that compounds value
failure_conditions: No strategic alignment = abort; no stress test = abort; no rollback = abort

success_criteria.signal_validation: Retention > 50% at 15 sec + positive sentiment > 0.7 + search signal present
success_criteria.interview_insight: At least 3 structured insights from interviews; at least 1 unexpected finding
success_criteria.product_validation: Conversion rate > baseline; retention > 30 days; feedback score > 0.7
success_criteria.agentic_layer: Agent activation < 30 sec; context pollution < 0.3; quality score > 0.6
